metadata.label: 3.2.5 TLS bench Web App capture smoke test
metadata.scenario: 3.2.5 connected to saved Wi-Fi, Web App open, stationary
metadata.coverage_notes: The trace followed a successful HTTPS update check. Raw GPS UART was active. The Web App suspends BLE and FANET. No flight or Leaf Log upload ran during the trace.
metadata.limitations: Short diagnostic capture. Review is required and there was no paired workload baseline.
